name: district_moves_formed_to_active_without_restamping_its_term_dates
distinguishing_aspect:
formed_on 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z and expiration_date 2027-08-01T00:00:00Z are stamped by the
FORMATION certification, so the FORMED -> ACTIVE advance moves status only: both dates come
back byte-identical to their pre-advance values even though effective_on is supplied.

setup: canonical district with the four-property roll
FORMATION drive CERTIFIED, so the district stands FORMED with its term dates stamped
logical clock 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z

name: activation_is_refused_once_the_assessable_roll_falls_below_the_petition_pool
distinguishing_aspect:
The FORMATION drive is still CERTIFIED and nothing about the district changed, but two
close-outs drop assessable_business_count from 4 to 2, below MIN_PETITION_POOL 3, so the
activation is refused with ERR_INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION and the district stays FORMED.

setup: canonical district FORMED with its FORMATION drive CERTIFIED
b2 and b3 closed out after certification, leaving 2 assessable properties

name: boundary_revision_executes_every_declared_side_effect_in_one_call
distinguishing_aspect:
One boundary revision to [ZONE_CORE] fires all five declared side effects at once: b3 and b4
move to OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY, b3's VALID signature becomes DISQUALIFIED with reason
OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY, the OPEN drive recomputes to signed_basis_cents 60000000 over
assessable_basis_snapshot_cents 80000000 = weighted_support_pct 0.7500, the district roll
falls to 2 / 80000000, and District.version increments exactly once.

setup: canonical district with the four-property roll and an OPEN FORMATION drive
b1 (ZONE_CORE) and b3 (ZONE_PERIMETER) have both signed
logical clock 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z, inside the drive window
assert: LodgingBusiness.${b1_id}.status is still ASSESSABLE and LodgingBusiness.${b2_id}.status is still ASSESSABLE

name: withdrawing_a_dispute_already_under_review_is_an_undeclared_transition
distinguishing_aspect:
WITHDRAW is declared only from SUBMITTED, so once the hearing officer has opened review the
operator's withdrawal returns ERR_INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION with HTTP 409 and the dispute
stays UNDER_REVIEW with appeal_count 0 — the operator cannot pull a docketed dispute.

setup: district ACTIVE, st1 filed 824,500
a CALCULATION_ERROR dispute on st1 moved SUBMITTED -> UNDER_REVIEW by the hearing officer

name: marketing_program_starts_planned_with_no_performance_figures_yet
distinguishing_aspect:
A newly created program is PLANNED with spend_frozen false, verified_room_nights 0, both
cost-per-room-night figures null, efficiency_tier null and performance_flag NOT_MEASURED —
program_performance has not run — while the funding plan's committed_program_cents already
reflects the 62000 commitment.

name: certified_drive_and_verified_claim_both_refuse_any_further_action

Two different terminal states are probed in one chain: re-tallying a CERTIFIED PetitionDrive
and re-verifying a VERIFIED RoomNightClaim both return ERR_INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION with

verified_room_nights stays 100.

name: second_sponsor_action_and_second_period_closure_are_both_refused

Replaying a succeeded trigger is refused on two unrelated machines: a second SPONSOR on a
BOARD_REVIEW plan and a second closure on a CLOSED period each return

period's billed_total_cents stays at the 824500 the first closure computed.

name: disestablishment_cascades_down_into_planned_programs_and_open_drives
distinguishing_aspect:
One lifecycle advance to DISESTABLISHED reaches two child entities and stops there: the OPEN
RENEWAL drive becomes WITHDRAWN and the PLANNED program becomes CANCELLED, while the already
terminal CERTIFIED formation drive and the APPROVED work plan are untouched.
